scope: Broad RL-method candidates in title plus abstract; not verified algorithm counts. DPO-only papers without RL terms are outside this default query. Categories may overlap and require manual model-family attribution.

topics.label: Autoregressive language
topics.description: RL training or fine-tuning of autoregressive language generators. Generic LLM RL papers are retrieved; reviewers must check the trained model, not just background mentions.
topics.query: Reinforcement learning fine-tuning of autoregressive large language models using policy gradients, PPO, GRPO, RLHF or verifiable rewards.

topics.label: Discrete diffusion language
topics.description: RL of categorical or masked diffusion language generators, including continuous-time discrete-state models. Not continuous embedding-space diffusion.
topics.query: Reinforcement learning post-training of discrete masked diffusion language models, optimizing token unmasking generators with policy gradients and rewards.

topics.label: Continuous diffusion language
topics.description: RL of continuous-state diffusion or flow-matching language generators in embedding/latent space. Continuous time alone does not qualify; reject papers whose only trained component is an external discrete controller.
topics.query: Reinforcement learning fine-tuning of continuous latent-space or embedding-space diffusion and flow-matching models for text generation, optimizing the continuous language generator.

topics.label: Flow-matching images
topics.description: RL of flow-matching or rectified-flow image generators. Generic image diffusion and flow policies for robot actions do not suffice.
topics.query: Reinforcement learning fine-tuning of flow-matching and rectified-flow text-to-image generative models such as FLUX using rewards and policy optimization.
